text:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout v2026.03.20-rc3 -> prod (change-window: 03/20 22:00-23:00 UTC). Traffic target: 10%.

sre-ana: flagged — p95 latency on /v1/embed jumped to ~1100ms at 3779012360, baseline ~320ms :warning:

kevin: seeing same in eu-west, 5xx rate up ~0.9% (normal <0.05%). looks correlated with prefix-caching miss rate.

maria: anyone else see error signature? logs show `CUDA out of memory` for some pods, but not all.

jason: stack traces point into quantize_v2 kernels - a few machine types (a100-80gb) hit oom during long seqs.

lucy: metric: `kvcache.miss_rate` spiked 4x; route sampling shows requests with seq_len>1024 disproportionately affected.

sre-ana: deploy-bot, pause traffic? we should halt rollout until we triage.

deploy-bot: Command received: PAUSE_ROLLOUT v2026.03.20-rc3 by @sre-ana. Traffic will be frozen at current allocations.

kevin: agree. let's pin routing for prod to v2026.03.18 (previous release) until we get a fix. Can ops do a quick rollback? @pm-oliver FYI.

pm-oliver: yep, hold on release notes update. need short postmortem. tag this as `release-hold`.

maria: ops: run `deploy rollback --to v2026.03.18 --scope prod --reason "quantize v2 OOMs"` ?

jason: before full rollback, can we route 80% to v2026.03.18 and keep 20% for debug? less blast radius.

lucy: that's fine. set fallback policy to `model_variant: legacy_fp16` for heavy seqs.

deploy-bot: Command received: TRAFFIC_SHIFT v2026.03.20-rc3 -> v2026.03.18 80/20 by @jason

deploy-bot: Traffic shift completed. New allocations: v2026.03.18=80%, v2026.03.20-rc3=20%.

sre-ana: monitoring: p95 back to ~350ms within 2 minutes. 5xx down to 0.08% after shift. good signal.

kevin: logs show remaining 5xxs are from cb batchers failing on seq>2048. we'll add a sequence-length firewall for the canary to stop long requests.

maria: patch ready: `gateway.rate_limit(seq_len>1024) -> 429 for v2026.03.20-rc3` — deploy when ready.

jason: agree, apply that rule and keep canary at 20% until next deploy window.

pm-oliver: write short incident note in release channel: "Paused rollout due to quantize_v2 memory regression; rolled 80% traffic back to v2026.03.18; mitigations applied." I'll draft.

lucy: follow-ups: (1) reproduce OOM in staging with long seqs, (2) test quantize_v2 kernel memory alignment, (3) add SLO alert gating for kvcache.miss_rate > 3x baseline.

sre-ana: tagging next steps into ops board. if canary is stable over 1hr we'll consider resuming with kernel fix or revert.

kevin: I'll open PR to disable quantize_v2 by default for prod builds until we confirm.

deploy-bot: Noting action items: rollback-shift, seq_len firewall, incident note. If you need a rollback runbook, see https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback

maria: thanks. marking this thread resolved for the immediate window. we should still keep an eye for related deploys.

pm-oliver: :thumbsup: please post a short postmortem and link to this thread. closing in 1h unless new alerts.
